lines.text: How's the knee been since last time?
Since last time it's moving a bit better, I managed the stairs at my sister's without the rail.
Brilliant. Keep doing the step-ups off the bottom stair, ten on each leg, twice a day.
Bring your trainers next time and we'll try some hopping.
Lovely, see you next week then. Mind how you go.
Mr Lindqvist? Hi, I'm Tom, come on through. How are you doing?
Not great to be honest, my right shoulder's been locked up since Saturday and I can't get my arm above my head.
Okay, let's get your coat off and start from the beginning.
